page.overview:
Who is Evgeny Harkonnen?

Evgeny Harkonnen was the uncle of Griffin, Valya and Tula Harkonnen.

Evgeny was living with his family on an isolated planet due to their family being disgraced. His nephew Griffin Harkonnen was trying to improve their family's status. His niece, Valya, disliked how slowly the progress was and encouraged Griffin to find Vorian Atreides and get him to take back his lies about their family, restoring their standing. Griffin tried to do this, but ended up dead, which the family blamed Valya for. They were further angered when Valya persuaded Tula to kill several members of the Atreides family in retaliation.

Years later, Valya returned home for the first time since leaving to commit to the Sisterhood. He said he never thought he'd live to see her return.

Evgeny was distrustful of Valya and told Harrow not to trust her. Despite this, Harrow followed Valya's plans. When they didn't work out how Valya wanted, Evgeny taunted her about this. They argued over the decisions Valya made that led to her leaving their family and joining the sisterhood. When Evgeny began to struggle to breathe, Valya picked up his treatment and kept it out of his reach until he fell to the floor and ultimately died.
